facts.fact: Decree 25/041 of 4 December 2025 creates the Registre Social Unique to pool and harmonise the household targeting systems of social programmes and to centralise beneficiaries' biographic, demographic and biometric data; the summary says it is to be interoperable with other information systems, and the full text is paywalled.
